title: Source: Big 12 monitoring Sorsby fallout, options

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Source: Big 12 monitoring Sorsby fallout, options
sources.description: The Big 12 presidents and chancellors haven't rushed to pull the league's recently filed federal lawsuit because there are still questions about Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby's NFL future and any possible legal retribution, a source told ESPN.
